title: EMC/EMI near-field simulator for KiCad PCBs
description: Free browser-based EMC/EMI tool: load a KiCad PCB and see its magnetic near field in 3D. Simulate clocks, buck converters, return paths and CISPR 32 emissions.
descriptionDe: Kostenloses EMV-Werkzeug im Browser: KiCad-Platine laden, magnetisches Nahfeld in 3D sehen und hören, Takte, Schaltregler, Rückstrompfade und CISPR 32 prüfen.
ogImageAlt: 3D view of a PCB with a glowing EMI near field, layout hints and a spectrum analyzer
applicationSubCategory: EMC / EMI simulation for printed circuit boards
features: Imports KiCad 6 to 10 boards (.kicad_pcb), detects reference planes
Quasi-static magnetic near-field simulation (Biot-Savart with image currents in reference planes)
Sources: clock and data lines, differential pairs, switching-regulator hot loops
3D field glow, slice plane, animated field lines, ant's-eye view
Virtual near-field probe with spectrum-analyzer view and sonification
Far-field estimate against CISPR 32 class B limits (3 m / 10 m)
Layout hints: return paths over plane gaps, reference changes at vias, missing stitching vias, hotspots
Return currents that detour around plane slots and jump through stitching vias or decoupling capacitors
Quasi-static electric field and inductor stray fields (open and shielded)
Near-field scanner: a 3D printer (OctoPrint or USB G-code) moves the probe, a tinySA measures; results compared with the simulation
Runs entirely in the browser; the board file never leaves the computer
